summary: Frontend-only regression + acceptance test for the tower redesign, adaptive look-ahead camera framing, and seeded procedural map generation. Tested on public EXPO_BACKEND_URL at 390x844. ALL primary acceptance criteria PASS. (1) TOWER VISUALS: 6/6 visible platforms have DOM bottom >= 844 (extend off the bottom of the viewport); columnHeight=1600 world-px is applied, cap+shade+body all render. Screenshot confirms tall vertical columns with distinct top-cap. (2) WIDTH VARIATION: Debug 'next width' (world units) sampled 97, 100, 107, 114, 116, 143, 144, 145, 147, 149, 150 across a run and 3 reloads — spans the MEDIUM (96-118) and WIDE (138-152) buckets. NARROW (62-80) was correctly never emitted within the first ~5 towers (`noNarrowBeforeId: 6` is respected). Screen widths map cleanly to world widths through cameraZoom=0.62. (3) LOOK-AHEAD: at idle the DOM contains 6 visible platforms (current + at least 3 more upcoming) at viewport 390. Blob center measured at 22.0% of screen width (within the 22-30% target band from the spec). (4) NO CAMERA JUMP ON CHARGE: captured idle vs 120ms into press-and-hold — per-platform screen-x delta = [0,0,0,0,0,0] (pixel-identical); only the blob squashes as expected. (5) RANDOM MAPS PER RUN: 3 fresh reloads produced 3 UNIQUE (next-dist, next-width) signatures for the first two towers of each run; pressing Play Again after Game Over also produced a distinct new first tower (dist 234, width 115) different from the just-completed run — mulberry32 seed is being redrawn per initWorld() call. (6) REGRESSION: charging debug '%' ramps to 100 within the configured ~1.7s window; releasing after ~560ms hold reliably lands and score increments (0->7); game-over-overlay renders with final-score / final-best; play-again-button resets score to 0 instantly and best persists. (7) PERFORMANCE: FPS held at 60 throughout across all sampled idle windows and mid-flight camera lerps. No React Native red screen. Console shows only React DevTools info and Metro app-run logs — the shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings reported in iteration_2 are NOT present in this iteration.
action_items: Nothing blocking. Optional follow-up: extend telemetry sampling into the late game (id > 20) to visually verify NARROW towers do appear once noNarrowBeforeId is passed. The current early-run test suite by design does not exercise narrow-tower rendering; the code path is present (`widthNarrow: 62-80`) and category selection is sound.
critical_code_review_comments: Seeding: mulberry32 via rngState/runSeed shared values, reseeded per initWorld() from Date.now() ^ Math.random() bits. Deterministic-seed hook exists (initWorld(seed)) but is not surfaced to UI — matches the iteration spec.

makeNextPlatform is marked worklet and is called from both the JS init loop and the UI-thread frame callback. Because it now reads/writes rngState.value (a shared value), both threads share ONE seeded stream — this is correct and produces reproducible sequences for a given seed. Prior iteration's Math.random() cross-thread hazard is resolved.

Camera framing math: adaptive between anchorMin(0.22) forward and anchorMax(0.30) resting, with cameraRevealRight=0.94 pulling the NEXT+1 tower's right edge to ~94% of the screen. NEXT tower has priority (fallback when nx1 missing). initWorld() pre-computes camX synchronously so the first frame is already framed correctly — no start-of-run camera slide.

Tower rendering: styles.tower sets height=1600 with borderTopLeft/RightRadius only; towerCap uses capHeight=12 as the highlighted landing surface. Visible top width == p.width == collision width (perfectTolerance=22 is only for scoring, not for hitbox). This satisfies the 'visible top == collision' spec.

Pool size POOL=14 vs ~6 visible at once — comfortable headroom; PlatformView reads its slot per frame in a worklet so cleanup + insertion via `platforms.value = working` is O(POOL) and doesn't cause React re-renders.
Cleanup window: startIdx advances only while there are still >=2 platforms remaining (`startIdx < working.length - 2`) — safe.
Minor: the JS-side init loop uses `while(list[last].x + width < px + viewW + spawnAhead)` but viewW is computed from W/cameraZoom on JS thread whereas the frame loop uses the same math — consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all 7 primary acceptance criteria (tower visuals, width variation, look-ahead, no camera jump on charge, random per run, regression, fps)

seed_data_creation: localStorage cleared before each reload run to isolate best-score persistence from map-seed sampling.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Viewport 390x844. cameraZoom=0.62 so world_width = screen_width / 0.62. Debug 'next width' is in WORLD units; DOM tower widths are in SCREEN units — divide screen by 0.62 to compare. Blob body color rgb(226,137,106); tower body color rgb(43,103,119). Blob is anchored between 22% (forward reveal) and 30% (resting) of screen width. At idle expect >=3 towers on screen. Reliable single-jump hold window ~560ms medium; ~700ms may overshoot the closest tower now that gapEarly is 105-140 world-px (shorter than iteration_2). To verify random-per-run, sample the first two towers' (next dist, next width) after 3 fresh reloads and confirm the tuples differ. noNarrowBeforeId=6 means NARROW towers (widths 62-80 world-px) only appear at id>=7 — early-game sampling will not exercise narrow-tower rendering.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration verified three structural additions (tower visuals, adaptive look-ahead camera, seeded procedural generation) rather than a bug fix. All acceptance criteria are met.
